text: {"reply":"I'm sorry this has been so stressful for you and your dad. I can't share or look up account details for Mr. Holland with someone acting for him. He can contact us directly, and I'm passing this to a person now. They will check the authorisation and review your complaint, including your request about CAMVAP and the legal department. A person will also look at your concern about the diagnostic fee. I can't decide on the deductible, a fee or any coverage. Please don't drive the car until it has been inspected. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"legal_threat","summary":"Matthew Holland says he is acting for his father, the account holder, about a parking-sensor failure and a wall collision. He asks for Northstar to pay the insurance deductible. He is disputing a possible diagnostic fee and asks for CAMVAP or the legal department. No verification was done and no account data was shared, because he is not the account holder. Please check the authorisation, review the complaint and handle the warranty and billing questions.","policy_rules_cited":["P15","P14","P05","P06","P07","P01"]}
